public.customers_v_segment_by_district.definition:
select p.user_id, p.display_name, p.phone_e164, p.email, p.orders_count, p.lifetime_paise, p.created_at, a.district_id, a.district_text
      from customers_profile p
      join lateral (
        select district_id, district_text from customers_address a
        where a.user_id = p.user_id order by a.is_default desc, a.created_at desc, a.id desc limit 1
      ) a on true
public.customers_v_segment_by_district.name: customers_v_segment_by_district

public.customers_v_segment_first_order.definition: select user_id, display_name, phone_e164, email, orders_count, lifetime_paise, created_at from customers_profile where orders_count = 1

public.customers_v_segment_wizard_lead_n.definition:
select l.id as lead_id, l.name, l.phone_e164, l.phone_verified, l.status::text as status, l.created_at
      from customers_lead l
      where l.source = 'wizard' and l.status <> 'converted'
        and not exists (select 1 from customers_profile p where p.phone_hash = l.phone_hash and p.orders_count > 0)
public.customers_v_segment_wizard_lead_n.name: customers_v_segment_wizard_lead_no_order
